t: This is Freedom Press, an anarchist publishing house and bookseller in Whitechapel, founded in 1886. Its founder, Charlotte Wilson, was an English Fabian and anarchist. She co-founded the Freedom newspaper that year with Peter Kropotkin. For its first decade she edited it, published it and largely financed it. She remained editor until 1895. So the press you're standing at owes its beginnings to her work, and to her money.
